summary: See exactly where your Claude spend goes, and which of it you could have avoided.
signature: 7 detectors, each naming a saving with its evidence
highlights: Splits spend into input, output, cache-write and cache-read, priced and ranked
Groups every turn under the prompt that started it, so cost maps to work
Seven detectors that each name a saving with the evidence behind it
requires: python3 (already on macOS and Linux). Reads ~/.claude/projects only. No network.
notes: Reads Claude Code's local transcripts, so it runs in the CLI only. There is nothing for it to read inside the Desktop or web sandbox.
